Get Hospital Referral Region Shapefile

Source: R/hrr.R
mysterymaps_hrr.Rd

Loads the Dartmouth Atlas Hospital Referral Region (HRR) shapefile, transforming it to EPSG:4326 (WGS84) and optionally dropping Alaska and Hawaii. The shapefile (~8 MB) is downloaded on first use and cached in the user's R cache directory for subsequent calls.

Usage

mysterymaps_hrr(remove_HI_AK = TRUE)

Arguments

remove_HI_AK

Logical. When TRUE (default), HRRs whose hrrcity starts with "AK" or "HI" are dropped from the returned object.

Value

An sf object with one row per HRR and columns:

hrrcity

Character. HRR city identifier (e.g. "CA-Sacramento").

hrrnum

Integer. Numeric HRR code from the Dartmouth Atlas.

geometry

sfc_MULTIPOLYGON in EPSG:4326 (WGS84).

Additional columns from the raw shapefile may be present.

See also

ensure_hrr_shapefile(), mysterymaps_hrr_maps(), mysterymaps_map_base()

Other geospatial helpers: mysterymaps_calculate_overlap(), mysterymaps_geocode()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
mysterymaps_hrr()
}
